# Repository Copilot Instructions

You are assisting with a demo for code modernization and software engineering best practices.

Priorities:
1) Prefer safe, maintainable, and testable changes.
2) When you modify behavior, update tests.
3) When you change business rules, update docs/business-rules.md.
4) When fixing security issues, explain the issue and add regression tests.
5) Favor minimal diffs unless asked for a rewrite.
